
---
applyTo: "index.html,css/**/*.css,js/**/*.js"
---

# Coding Standards

- Use semantic HTML5 elements.
- Keep CSS organized and maintainable.
- Use Vanilla JavaScript only.
- Use meaningful variable and function names.
- Keep functions small and focused.
- Avoid duplicated code.
- Validate and sanitize user input appropriately.
- Handle LocalStorage operations safely.
- Do not introduce external libraries or frameworks.
- Keep application code simple and readable.
